expansion: Matched-budget evidence killed the claim that plain local CA dynamics were adding search power on either the 167/80 support space or the modular-seed lift task.
The reserve branch has to change the information channel, not just the move schedule.
Useful survivors look like proof-carrying filters, adaptive exact-feedback loops, or multiscale memory systems rather than another homogeneous local search.
The unresolved object is already a sharply specified support-recognition problem rather than an open-ended matrix search.
Because 167 and 80 are coprime, each cyclic orbit admits a unique canonical path representative.
That makes orbit quotienting native to the state description instead of an after-the-fact audit.
Read cellar literally as stack memory: a pushdown or grammar-like automaton, not a typo for another 1D cellular rule.
The stack stores deferred autocorrelation debt, parity debt, and symmetry obligations.
Acceptance means extendable prefix, not merely a low heuristic score.
Run lengths, ascent/descent markers, and ballot-style prefixes are more natural than raw 167-bit strings once the orbit is canonically fixed.
The path word becomes a compressed proof object that can be checked, rejected, or completed.
This is the cleanest way to preserve the 167/80 target while being materially different from H1.
Debt behaves like an inventory ledger: each prefix spends some future pair-count budget and leaves deficits that must be discharged later.
A stack is a natural place to hold debt at multiple interval scales.
This suggests a multiscale parser or decoder, not a flat greedy updater.
Unsat cores and completion failures are not just final verdicts; they can become reusable forbidden motifs.
Programmatic SAT and user propagators fit naturally here because the exact layer can shape later automaton transitions.
This moves the reserve branch from static pruning to adaptive symbolic search.
The seed remains valuable as a structured source of motifs and as a plateau benchmark, but not as license to rerun flat defect transport.
Any seed-side reserve must add memory, hierarchy, or a different proposal source.
Otherwise it is just H2 with different branding.
Recent controllability results imply many CA rule families cover only a vanishing fraction of state space at scale.
After H1 and H2, reachability has to be a gatekeeper or a reason to leave homogeneous CA behind.
The reserve branch should earn budget only if it exposes a frontier the old rules could not even represent.
Gram defects and correlation deficits behave like syndromes or messages rather than generic energies.
The right analogy is local decoding with explicit certificates, not unguided hill-climbing.
This keeps a seed-side reserve alive only in hierarchical or message-passing form.
Quaternionic, spectral, or incidence-design objects may still matter, but only as proposal compilers behind a strong exact frontier filter.
Without a filter, they are too unconstrained and too far from the actual obstruction.
The reserve architecture therefore wants filter first, latent proposals second.

forced_bridges.from: canonical path representative of the 167/80 support
forced_bridges.mechanism: Encode each path step or run token as a symbol, then let stack frames store deferred multiscale convolution debt so only prefixes with legal completions survive.

forced_bridges.from: SAT+CAS and programmatic SAT for Williamson, Golay, and good-matrix searches
forced_bridges.mechanism: Translate unsat cores and propagator callbacks into forbidden local motifs, stack-transition vetoes, or weighted penalties that update the frontier filter online.
Run reachability checks on small controls before any large experiment so rule families with provably poor coverage never become active branches.

forced_bridges.from: cellular-automaton decoders and multiscale toric-code automata
forced_bridges.mechanism: Replace flat defect transport with coarse-to-fine message passing or stacked debt buckets that coordinate nonlocal cancellations across row blocks.
Treat the exact completion oracle as a teacher answering prefix-extendability queries and distill those answers into a compact learned acceptor.
Freeze a heterogeneous local dynamical substrate on path or defect states and train only a readout that predicts promising flips or accepted extensions.

forced_bridges.from: quaternionic, spectral, or incidence-geometry latent objects
forced_bridges.mechanism: Use richer latent proposals only if the canonical-path filter and exact completion checks can score them cheaply and expose measurable enrichment.

anomaly_results.constraint: Require the reserve branch to be materially different from the retired local-search CA loops
anomaly_results.result: Pure density-classifier, flat decoder, or CA-annealer variants do not qualify on their own because fairness already neutralized the value of that move-budget story.
The state space collapses to one canonical orbit word per support, so an automaton can search orbit representatives directly instead of rediscovering cyclic duplicates.

anomaly_results.constraint: Demand proof objects instead of only low defect or low autocorrelation distance
anomaly_results.result: The literal cellar branch gets stronger because each accepted prefix, rejected prefix, learned motif, or exact completion certificate is auditable in a way that score-only heuristics are not.

anomaly_results.constraint: Force the automaton to carry every one of the 83 target autocorrelation coordinates exactly at every prefix
anomaly_results.result: The model risks collapsing into exact branch-and-bound or SAT. A workable version should track compressed debt summaries and call the exact layer only on a narrowed frontier.

anomaly_results.constraint: Inject exact conflict feedback after each failed completion
anomaly_results.result: The branch changes from static pruning to adaptive symbolic learning; repeated failures can become short forbidden motifs or transition guards rather than fresh dead ends.

anomaly_results.constraint: Restart from the 64-modular seed but forbid flat local repair
anomaly_results.result: A multiscale decoder or reservoir-style controller remains plausible, while a translation-invariant defect-transport CA does not.

anomaly_results.constraint: Evaluate pruning only on random or raw-bit negative controls
anomaly_results.result: The apparent gain can be illusory. The branch must also preserve solved same-template witnesses and beat matched compressed-representation baselines.

anomaly_results.constraint: Learn automaton states only from toy orders
anomaly_results.result: The model may memorize small cases and fail to transfer. Transfer to the exact 167 template has to be treated as a first-class gate, not an afterthought.

steering_directions.direction: Canonical-path cellar automaton with deferred autocorrelation debt
steering_directions.rationale: This is the cleanest materially different reserve branch. It keeps the exact 167/80 obstruction but replaces local CA dynamics with a pushdown-style acceptor on canonical orbit words, where stack state carries unresolved convolution debt.
steering_directions.first_step: Define the unique path or run-length encoding for weight-80 subsets of Z_167, then implement a prefix-feasibility checker whose state is position, used weight, low-order debt, and a stack of interval deficits.
steering_directions.expected_signal: Known smaller 4 x p witnesses survive, random prefixes die early, and the surviving frontier is dramatically smaller than raw backtracking without losing positive controls.

steering_directions.direction: Proof-carrying pushdown plus SAT user-propagator learning
steering_directions.rationale: The pushdown filter should not remain static. Exact solvers in related Hadamard searches already expose conflicts, and those conflicts can be recycled into reusable local vetoes or transition weights.
steering_directions.first_step: Wrap the prefix filter around a small exact completion solver, record unsat cores for failed completions, and cluster them into forbidden path motifs or stack-transition exclusions.
steering_directions.expected_signal: Solver calls become rarer over time, repeated cores stabilize into reusable motifs, and the adaptive filter beats the static one on end-to-end frontier reduction.

steering_directions.direction: Hierarchical debt decoder for the modular-seed side
steering_directions.rationale: If any seed-side reserve survives H2, it has to add memory and scale separation rather than rerun flat defect transport. Multiscale decoder literature suggests hierarchy is the main missing ingredient once homogeneous local rules stall.
steering_directions.first_step: Build a coarse-to-fine defect pyramid on smaller perturbed exact Hadamards, where each level aggregates Gram defects over row blocks and passes cancellation requests downward before touching the 668 seed.
steering_directions.expected_signal: The hierarchical decoder crosses plateaus that trap flat greedy and flat CA controls, with gains surviving matched-neighborhood fairness checks on injected-defect controls.

steering_directions.direction: Learned automaton frontier from exact membership queries
steering_directions.rationale: Active learning of compact automata offers a way to distill exact extendability checks into a reusable frontier recognizer, preserving the literal automaton interpretation without requiring every transition to be hand-crafted.
steering_directions.first_step: Generate labeled prefixes from smaller solved cyclic instances and exact completability queries, then fit a compact weighted or finite-state acceptor that predicts extendability before escalation to the exact layer.
steering_directions.expected_signal: The learned recognizer compresses the feasible frontier with low false-negative rate on known witnesses and transfers better than simple handcrafted local bounds.

steering_directions.direction: Latent proposal compiler behind the exact filter
steering_directions.rationale: Quaternionic, spectral, and incidence-design proposal spaces remain interesting only if the new frontier filter can cheaply tell whether they land in promising regions. Otherwise they are too far from the actual obstruction to justify priority.
steering_directions.first_step: Pick one latent family at small orders, transduce it into candidate block or path words, and measure enrichment only after the canonical-path filter and exact completion checks are applied.
steering_directions.expected_signal: A right-tail shift appears after filtering, not just before. If enrichment disappears under exact checks, the latent family is decorative and should be dropped.

validation_checks.direction: Canonical-path cellar automaton with deferred autocorrelation debt
checks: Canonicalization check: every sampled weight-80 support and all of its cyclic shifts map to one path word.
Positive-control check: all known smaller 4 x p witnesses reach accepting terminal states.
Pruning check: against an exact completability oracle on smaller instances, the filter rejects at least 99 percent of random prefixes by mid-depth while keeping every positive-control prefix.
Fairness check: compare against a non-automaton search that uses the same path representation and the same exact-oracle budget.
Kill condition: if the gain comes only from representation compression and not from automaton state or stack memory, retire the branch.

validation_checks.direction: Proof-carrying pushdown plus SAT user-propagator learning
checks: Core locality check: extracted unsat cores compress to short motifs or stack conditions rather than full-instance clauses.
Reuse check: motifs learned on one smaller control reduce solver calls on held-out controls of the same template.
Safety check: learned vetoes never eliminate known positive witnesses.
End-to-end check: static filter plus exact solver is outperformed by adaptive filter plus exact solver under the same completion budget.
Kill condition: if cores stay global and non-reusable, this collapses back into ordinary exact search packaging.

validation_checks.direction: Hierarchical debt decoder for the modular-seed side
checks: Plateau check: on injected-defect controls, hierarchy reaches lower defect energy or exact repair where flat greedy and flat CA controls stall.
Ablation check: remove the coarse levels and confirm the advantage disappears.
Seed fairness check: use the same start state, flip neighborhood, accepted-move budget, and verifier as the nonhierarchical baseline.
Transfer check: improvements on small controls predict improvements on the structured 668 seed rather than vanishing at scale.
Kill condition: if the gains do not survive ablation or fairness controls, retire this direction.

validation_checks.direction: Learned automaton frontier from exact membership queries
checks: Teacher-fidelity check: the learned model matches exact extendability labels on held-out prefixes with near-zero false negatives on positives.
Compression check: the learned model uses substantially fewer states or features than a naive explicit prefix table.
Transfer check: training on smaller orders still improves frontier scoring on the 167 template.
Comparison check: the learned automaton beats simple low-order autocorrelation bounds and handcrafted run-length heuristics.
Kill condition: if the learner memorizes toy orders and fails to transfer, keep only handcrafted exact filters.

validation_checks.direction: Latent proposal compiler behind the exact filter
checks: Enrichment check: filtered latent proposals beat random and direct local perturbations on exact completability or modular admissibility at small orders.
Decoder check: the transduction into path words or block tuples is deterministic and auditable.
Fairness check: compare against equally many proposals from matched nonlatent generators.
Kill condition: if enrichment vanishes once exact filtering is applied, the latent space is decorative and should be dropped.

sub_problem: What materially different reserve branch, including a literal 'cellar automata' interpretation, remains after H1 and H2 failed the fairness-corrected gates on the 167/80 obstruction and the 64-modular 668 seed?
